description: This Java class defines a message envelope used for messaging within the Eclipse Ditto framework, specifically for messages to PersistenceActors. It includes JSON serialization/deserialization, header management, and equality/hashCode implementations.

classes.name: ShardedMessageEnvelope
classes.description: A message envelope for messages to PersistenceActors, containing an ID, type, message content, and headers, with JSON serialization/deserialization and equality methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ShardedMessageEnvelope instance with specified id, type, message, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JsonObject to create a ShardedMessageEnvelope instance.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the envelope.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the envelope to a JsonObject.
